gloss: to sleep, to go to bed

definitions.explanation: To be in a state of sleep. The basic verb for sleeping.

definitions.gloss: to go to bed, to lie down
definitions.explanation: To get into bed or to lie down, whether or not one actually sleeps.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんはもう{寝|ね}ている。
{昨日|きのう}は{八時間|はちじかん}{寝|ね}ました。
examples.english: I slept for eight hours yesterday.

examples.japanese: {疲|つか}れていたので、{電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{寝|ね}てしまった。{駅|えき}を{乗|の}り{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I was tired, so I fell asleep on the train. I missed my stop.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}は{十一時|じゅういちじ}に{寝|ね}た。
examples.english: I went to bed at 11 o'clock yesterday.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}を{引|ひ}いたので、{寝|ね}ていた。
examples.english: I had a cold, so I was lying in bed.

examples.japanese: {疲|つか}れたからベッドに{寝|ね}たい。
examples.english: I'm tired, so I want to lie down in bed.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{十二時|じゅうにじ}に{寝|ね}て、{七時|しちじ}に{起|お}きる。{朝|あさ}は{少|すこ}し{眠|ねむ}い。
examples.english: I go to bed at 12 o'clock every day and wake up at 7. I'm a little sleepy in the morning.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xが{寝|ね}る (X sleeps).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {寝|ね}ている = 'is sleeping/asleep' (state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{早|はや}く{寝|ね}る (go to bed early)
・{寝|ね}ている (is sleeping)
・{寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に (before sleeping)
・{寝坊|ねぼう}する (to oversleep)

Opposite: {起|お}きる (to wake up/get up).
